events.description: The morning pool: weight = base + per-point bias per faction standing + per-heat x heat + per-day x day (GDD 5.2), clamped at 0.

standing_bias.description: Additive weight per standing point of a faction - a bias may be negative.

per_heat.description: Additive weight per heat point - this is how the police raid finds you.

per_day.description: Additive weight per campaign day - the city changes as days pass.

effects.description: What the morning's pick does to the shift (GDD 5.2): bodies through the door and the flow of orders. The music shift waits on event music sets (content).

crowd_delta.description: Bodies added to (or taken out of) the room for the day - negative during a raid.

orders_multiplier.description: Flow of orders against the baseline: 1.0 untouched, above it a busier bar, below it a slower one.
